meta.title: BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance
meta.aggregation: Flight-level records aggregated by date, day of week, two-hour scheduled departure window, reporting carrier, and origin airport.

metricDefinitions.averageDelayMinutes: Arrival delay minutes / delayed arrivals, limited to completed flights with ArrDel15 = 1

preparationNotes: Cancelled and diverted flights are excluded from arrival-performance denominators.
Blank delay-cause values are treated as zero because BTS reports causes only when applicable.
All origin airports are retained as individually selectable categories.
Scheduled departure times are grouped into twelve two-hour local-time windows.
